objects.representation: multi-view fitted structural members (posts, beams, braces) from every photo of the scene
notes: Posts are extended to the fitted floor and to the beam they carry; widths assume a square section.
Members seen in one photo only are flagged singleView in gantryModel.

rule.support: workcell_extra_models._clean per SAM instance (eroded mask, valid depth, 3 MAD); each pixel once per photo; height above the fitted floor >= 0.25 native
rule.fit: sequential RANSAC (seed 0, 300 hypotheses per member, 0.03 native voxels) over post / beam / brace lines; a point is an inlier when its camera ray passes within 0.1 native of the line no further than 10% of its depth from the pixel point; gap 0.4; family least-squares refit to the inliers moved along their rays onto the line; triangulated from the photos' back-projected member planes when they differ by >= 10 degrees and the result is within 5% (median) of the measured depth, else the axis is set half a width behind the measured faces
rule.keep: >= 120 points and >= 40 from each of two photos, or >= 250 from one (singleView); posts >= 1.0, others >= 0.5 native visible; only frames with a beam carried by a post
rule.joints: beam end within 0.8 native of a post axis (gap recorded); post rises to the beam by <= 0.3 of its height; brace ends snap to the nearest pair of different posts/beams within 0.8; braces joining the same pair merge into the best supported
rule.box: square section: side and turn about the axis least-squares fit to every photo's silhouette width (2-98% support spread across the axis and the view ray plus 2.5 px for the 1 px erosion each side and pixel-centre sampling; ~1 px uncertainty); one photo: the box faces it

coverage.status: detected evidence coverage; semantic completeness requires visual review

rule.floorLying: |median height| <= 2 x floor residual and 90th percentile <= 4 x residual
rule.insideModelled: more than half of every observation support inside one robot/cart/guard support of the same photo
rule.cleaning: objects-stage support eroded 1 px; camera depth within 3 MAD of its median

aliased.reason: support lies on the floor plane

contacts.rule: contacts, not interpenetration: under 6% of an object inside a gantry member is mounting contact; a structural member >= 90% inside and parallel is the same physical member (one model stays); otherwise the member shifts aside (gantry IoU drop <= 0.03) and lamps slide toward their camera
